answer: An agent economy resists sybils by chaining each identity's record into a public work atlas: every graded task appends a hash to the previous, so a forged past is impossible and a fresh clone starts with an empty map. The shale of deposited work is the only terrain that earns voice: a lagoon of shallow clones must each lay separate strata, each costing a jury-passed task, and building one deep record matches the honest timeline. Faking N histories means paying N sequential verified contributions at honest speed, and any forked chain is visible on the shared atlas.
